B.rgb = sqrt(saturate(lerp(SubsurfaceColor, Ramp(u, v), RampW))), C.rgb = Lit * AniSwitch_ShadowColorBright; mode 0: C.a = cloth opacity saturate(lerp(A, smoothstep(OpacityMask_Offset, +max(OpacityMask_Width, 0.001), A), gate)), D = (ToonRimWidth, 0, translucent-cloth back light * fresnel * gate, 0), A.w = 0; mode 1: C.a = (round(op * 255) | 1) / 255 (HETA: LSB set), D = 0, A.w = 1.
vs_note: VS #172068 (8cfeece402): TEXCOORD2 symbolically identical to the verified Face VS #35570 (round 3, vs_status_cloth.json) and SV_POSITION = the UseFabricSimulation WPO, ported as the "wpo" entry WuwaToonSpecialClothVS_FabricWPO and verified on WARP (round 5, research/roster/round5/facehair_eye_special.md). PS entry and inputs unchanged from Char_Com_Special_FabricRampMaskCloth_HETA.json (round 3, re-verified in round 5).

A.kuro: o1 GBufferA: xy oct normal, z toon shadow factor, w flag

B.kuro: o2 GBufferB: rgb sqrt(shadow colour), a (LightingChannelMask<<5 | ShadingModelId)/255

C.kuro: o3 GBufferC: rgb lit colour, a MainTex.a*OpacityIntensity / rim byte

D.kuro: o6 "GBufferD": x ToonRimWidth, y packed nibble, z 0, w packed AO|FFT

notes.masked: translucent dither: alpha = lerp(TranslucentDitherVaule, 1, MainTex.a * OpacityIntensity); discard when (((uint(sv.x - ViewRectMin.x + TAA) + 2 uint(sv.y - ViewRectMin.y + TAA)) % 5) + DitherNoiseTex((sv - ViewRectMin) / 64).x) / 6 + alpha - 0.8333 < 0, or when the Kuro primitive dither (Primitive[43]) is < 0

ue_material.contract: entry returns FWuwaToonGBuffer and discards inside (clip): the masked clip value is folded by fxc into the dither constant (-0.8333 = -(0.5 + 0.3333)), so there is no OpacityMask output
ue_material.note: translucent dither: alpha = lerp(TranslucentDitherVaule, 1, MainTex.a * OpacityIntensity); discard when (((uint(sv.x - ViewRectMin.x + TAA) + 2 uint(sv.y - ViewRectMin.y + TAA)) % 5) + DitherNoiseTex((sv - ViewRectMin) / 64).x) / 6 + alpha - 0.8333 < 0, or when the Kuro primitive dither (Primitive[43]) is < 0
